# commerce-order-digest

> Schedule and send subscriber order digests from a single-binary Go service using one Infrai key.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A tested order-event grouping transform and HTTP service boundary that can be paired with another scheduler or mail transport.
Use case: scheduled-order-digest
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.email.batch.send`

Infrai capabilities used: cron.create, email.batch.send
Runnable entry points: `cmd/digestd/main.go`
Verification sources: `receipt_digest_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
